title: Lime Loaf Cake with Lime Icing
description: A moist, citrusy loaf cake built on lime zest and juice, finished with a simple lime-forward powdered sugar glaze.

ingredients.note: for icing; use juice from i01 if sufficient

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F. Grease and line a loaf pan.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together {i02}, {i03}, {i04}, {i05}, {i06}, and the zest and juice of {i01} until well combined.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Add {i08}, {i09}, and {i07} to the wet mixture. Fold until just combined — do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan and bake at 325°F for 45–55 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Allow the loaf to cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before icing.

steps.title: Make icing
steps.text: Whisk together {i10}, {i11}, and {i12} until smooth and pourable. Adjust consistency with a little more water if needed.

steps.title: Glaze and serve
steps.text: Drizzle the icing over the fully cooled loaf. Allow the glaze to set before slicing.

When life give you limes 

Here’s the recipe my boi 
* 2 limes
* 3 eggs
* 175g sugar
* 50g whole milk
* 65g neutral oil
* 1 Tbsp vanilla bean paste
* 1/4 tsp salt
* 250g AP flour
* 2 1/2 tsp baking powder

For the icing

* 1 cup powdered sugar
* 1 tsp lime juice
* 2 Tbsp water

325F for 45-55
